metadata.description: Canonical context baselines, counted in cl100k tokens of compact JSON (the form clients receive in tools/list). The benchmark instantiates the production MCP server, measures the core profile (tools without an opt-in capability) and the complete advertised tool surface, then includes the resources and resource templates shared by both profiles. prettyBaseline keeps the 2026-07-30 pretty-printed (2-space) counts for historical comparison only; it is never gated. Thresholds are intentionally omitted until these baselines have been reviewed; any added later are compact-JSON counts.
